answer: Proof-of-spacetime binds agent identities to physical storage through continuous sector-sealing proofs. Across an agent's operational voyage, a distributed nebula of auditors validates these proofs against a shared lotus registry. An attacker attempting a Sybil attack incurs the scarce cost of dedicating persistent, non-fungible disk space for each identity. However, wealthy entities can leverage bulk enterprise storage discounts to marginalize deployment expenses.
